resources.string: Tap a class to see its time, location, teacher, and weeks.
Tap + on the timetable, then choose Import from your university. Search for your school, then choose plugin or general import.
Search by course, teacher, or location in the management list. Long-press an entry to select and manage several at once.
Open Reminders from the sidebar to see upcoming alarms and class notifications.
See what each permission does and whether it is enabled. Grant only what you need and return here to manage access.

Let CurSimple run in the background to keep reminders on time.
Let auto-silence switch to silent or Do Not Disturb mode.
Find writable calendars and add course events when you sync.
